## Product Description 

### Presenting a Nendoroid [Basic] of Frieren!

From "Frieren: Beyond Journey's End" comes a Nendoroid [Basic] of Frieren, depicted as she appears when receiving her ring in episode 14 of the anime! What is Nendoroid [Basic]? Nendoroid [Basic] is a lineup of Nendoroids that omit face plates and optional parts, resulting in more affordability and faster production! They feature the same functionality as regular Nendoroids, allowing them to share interchangeable hand parts, leg parts, head parts and face plates with other Nendoroids!
